executive_summary.overall_condition: The property has several structural issues that require immediate attention.
executive_summary.executive_summary: The inspection report highlights several areas of concern, including structural damage due to cracks on the external wall, water ingress through joints and disturbance in slope, and possible structural damage or water ingress. Additionally, there are issues with capillary action due to accumulated moisture and terrace screed has lost its strength. It is recommended to investigate and repair the cracks, ensure waterproofing and slope stability, and address the source of moisture accumulation. Further investigation and repair of the cracks on the external wall are also necessary to prevent further damage.

Note: * Structural cracks deserve immediate attention. They indicate that the structure of the building, or at least a part of it, is overstressed. A structure, when stressed beyond its capacity, may collapse without further warning signs. When such cracks suddenly develop, or appear to widen and/or spread, the findings must be reported immediately to the Structural Engineer, Buildings Department. A building professional such as a Registered Structural Engineer is usually required to investigate the cause(s) of the cracks, to assess their effects on the structure, to propose suitable rectification and remedial works, and supervise the carrying out of such works.
